analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize the existing software system by building from the Discover baseline.
requirements_understanding: The modernization effort should preserve existing functionality while improving maintainability.
Explicit error handling and observability requirements must be defined.
Measurable non-functional requirements are necessary to ensure system performance and reliability.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Use a modular architecture to facilitate maintainability and scalability.

Define performance benchmarks and reliability targets.

output.executive_summary: This project aims to modernize the existing software system by building from the Discover baseline, ensuring improved maintainability and performance.

functional_requirements.title: Preserve Legacy Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all existing functionalities from the legacy system are preserved in the modernized system.
acceptance_criteria: All legacy features are available in the new system.
User workflows remain unchanged unless specified.
Data integrity is maintained throughout the transition.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Modular Architecture
functional_requirements.description: Adopt a modular architecture to enhance system maintainability and scalability.
acceptance_criteria: Modules are independently deployable.
System components can be updated without affecting others.
Clear module interfaces are defined and documented.

functional_requirements.title: Enhance Error Handling
functional_requirements.description: Define and implement comprehensive error handling mechanisms.
acceptance_criteria: All errors are logged with sufficient detail for troubleshooting.

Critical errors trigger alerts to the support team.

functional_requirements.title: Integrate Logging and Monitoring
functional_requirements.description: Implement logging and monitoring to improve system observability.
acceptance_criteria: All critical operations are logged with timestamps.
System health metrics are monitored in real-time.
Alerts are configured for predefined thresholds.

acceptance_criteria: Data migration plan is documented and approved.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).

blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.
